reviewTitle: Randomly connect to phone when in charging case!
reviewDescription: If you would have asked me 6 months ago, I would have told you these are my favorite ear buds. They're comfortable for my small ears. The sound quality is good. They stay charged a long time. I even bought a second set to throw into my work bag. But why 1 star now, you ask? Let me tell you. These ear buds randomly start connecting to my phone when they're docked in the charging case (ie NOT in your ear where you can hear anything). This is a HUGE problem if you have a job that requires you to be on call and be able to hear your phone ring! I've tried cleaning the charging pins and connections and everything the trouble shooting suggests, but they still randomly connect. And they have a crazy far distance the bluetooth can reach; buds can be upstairs on the nightstand, and me and my phone can be downstairs and they'll connect. Both pairs of Back Bay ear buds I own eventually started doing this, so I'm inclined to think it's a flaw in the design somewhere. So I guess I'm off to find another set of affordable ear buds that I love, because I can't have these things costing me my job.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on October 18, 2026
